scope: AST-only report-to-helper source trace. It follows statically imported or same-module local functions that resolve to unique Python definitions under services/. It records direct execute/query sites and statically checkable positional bind arity and named bind contracts in the bounded local call closure without retaining SQL text or values. Unique unshadowed literal module strings are resolved; computed or reassigned module values remain unresolved. The shared database query forwarding adapter is recorded separately, with SQL counted at its caller site. For literal same-module filter-return helpers, a conditional location signal is recorded only when a returned location predicate is paired with the caller's location_id argument; alternative organization/no-filter variants are preserved separately. A location-scope signal is not proof of correct tenant authorization. Unresolved imports, dynamic dispatch, indirect function values, external providers, runtime call selection, database views, and semantic report behavior are not proven. No service is imported or executed and no database, provider, or secret is accessed.
